title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – price basis 2027, proposal for a 24-month agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.17 (po:4500013023-10) through EUR 5.24 (po:4500013392-10), EUR 5.43 (po:4500013795-10) to EUR 5.45 (po:4500014455-10) between 2025-10-06 and 2026-09-24. That rise is already in our price.

Your letter of 6 July says your nickel and alloys requirement is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so we propose a fixed price without a surcharge clause. In return we offer a 24-month commitment covering 94800 kg per year. That gives you secure volume and planning certainty.

Please find two complete packages attached. Your owner kindly offered to walk us through your calculation. We would welcome that if it helps settle the price quickly.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – price basis 2027, proposal for a 24-month agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We welcome your proposal for a 24-month commitment and have reduced our price to €5.36 to reflect this extended volume and the historical data you provided. As a 24-month agreement extends beyond our current fixed-price coverage for raw materials, we must include the AS-14404 index clause to manage the risk. We have maintained the 30-day payment term from your second option to support this competitive pricing.

Our main offer is a price of €5.31 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.36 per unit.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Part:370010 - fixed-price package for 24 months
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for verifying our price history.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

We understand your concern about the period after your fixed-price coverage. Your letter of 6 July states that your nickel and alloys requirement is covered until March 2027. This covers the first months of the contract. A fixed price keeps administration simple for both sides and removes monthly surcharge calculations from your workload.

The attached package covers 94800 kg per year over 24 months, with no surcharge clause. Could you make it your primary standing offer?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part:370010 - fixed-price package for 24 months
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

As our fixed-price coverage for raw materials ends in March 2027, we cannot offer a fixed price for a 24-month agreement and must include the AS-14404 index clause. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. We have maintained the 90-day payment term and the 24-month contract duration exactly as you proposed.

Our proposal stands at a price of €5.12 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: a price of €5.24 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 - revised fixed-price package, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for checking our data.

We have moved our price a real step toward you in the attached package. It keeps the same structure: 94800 kg per year over 24 months, 90 days payment and no surcharge clause.

Your letter of 6 July confirms that your nickel and alloys requirement is covered at fixed prices until March 2027. A fixed price for our full two-year volume gives you a secure order book and saves the monthly surcharge administration on both sides.

Could you make this package your primary standing offer? If a fixed price is not possible, which cheaper variant would you suggest?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 - revised fixed-price package, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your revised offer; we acknowledge your movement and have adjusted our price accordingly. Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot), so we kindly ask you to decide. This Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

Our offer is a price of €5.07 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. As our fixed-price coverage ends in March 2027, a 24-month agreement must include the AS-14404 index clause. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.19 per unit.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
